proof.why_unobtainable: Requested counterevidence is a passing health check on a reachable macOS runner. The reachable-runner inventory is a closed, enumerable set and contains zero macOS hosts, so the observation is not in the obtainable-evidence set.

settling_experiment.description: Add one reachable macOS runner to the inventory and re-run the health probe on that host.
settling_experiment.would_falsify_if: The health probe returns pass on that newly attached macOS runner.
